# Glasshouse Project

The glasshouse combines a quiet structure with expressive material choices.
That makes it a useful metaphor for theme architecture.

## Constraints

- Preserve the semantic structure.
- Let the selected theme control composition.
- Keep explicit user overrides authoritative.
